title: Browns GM Andrew Berry calls Jerry Jeudy "our bell cow" after drafting two wideouts

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Browns GM Andrew Berry calls Jerry Jeudy "our bell cow" after drafting two wideouts
sources.description: The Browns selected wide receivers with two of their first three draft picks, but General Manager Andrew Berry said that isn't going to change Jerry Jeudy's role in the offense.
